answer: A refundable stake bond, hard to amass as a quartz vein, must lock before any agent can bid, then unlocks slowly only as verified peers attest honest work — standing that accrues like jade earning its polish over many epochs. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond per fake identity and wait each one through its own vesting window, so a single correlated ripple of sockpuppet accounts forfeits capital at every head. Sybil cost scales linearly, never for free.
